start: On a phone: "Create my gym" form, filled and terms ticked; checking by WhatsApp is on

steps.action: Tap the green "Verify with WhatsApp"
user_sees: Button reads "Please wait…"; WhatsApp opens with a message ready to send to the MettleUp number
"Send it from the WhatsApp on this number. A message from another number does not work."
must_not: A message sent by itself
A charge or a paid SMS

steps.action: Tap Send in WhatsApp without changing the message, come back to the page
user_sees: "Send the message in WhatsApp", the message and "To: MettleUp, <number>"
"Checking your message…" and "This code works for <n> more minutes."
must_not: The page started over with the typed values gone
The check stopped because the page was in the background

steps.action: Wait a few seconds
user_sees: Green "Number checked" and "+91 <number> is yours."; the main button becomes "Create my gym"
must_not: "Number checked" without a message from this number
A second message needed

start: On a computer: "Create my gym" form, filled and terms ticked

steps.action: Tap "Verify with WhatsApp"
user_sees: A QR code and "Scan with the phone that has +91 <number>"
"1. Open the camera on that phone and point it at the code." "2. WhatsApp opens with the message ready. Tap Send." "3. This page turns green by itself."
"No camera? Send "<text>" to <number> on WhatsApp."
must_not: A new window opened to WhatsApp Web by itself

steps.action: Scan with the phone, tap Send
user_sees: The computer page turns to "Number checked" by itself
must_not: A refresh needed
The check passed by a scan from a phone with another number

start: "Create my gym" form, filled and terms ticked; the older way is on (MettleUp sends a code)

steps.action: Tap "Get code on WhatsApp"
user_sees: "We sent a 6-digit code to +91 <number> on WhatsApp. It works for 10 minutes."
Box "Code from WhatsApp", button "Send a new code"
must_not: A code sent to a number other than the typed one

steps.action: Type the code
user_sees: With "Create my gym": the gym is made
must_not: A wrong, used or 10-minute-old code accepted

start: "Create my gym" form, filled and terms ticked; the waiting page is showing

steps.action: Send the message from a WhatsApp on a different number
user_sees: Red line "We got your message from a different number. Send it from the WhatsApp on +91 <number>."
must_not: The number marked as checked

steps.action: Change the message before sending
user_sees: "We could not find the code in your message. Tap "Open WhatsApp again" and send it without changes."
must_not: The number marked as checked
Silence with no hint

steps.action: Do not send anything; stay on the page 20 seconds after coming back
user_sees: A calm note "We have not got your message yet. In WhatsApp, check that the message to MettleUp was sent. If it was not, tap “Open WhatsApp again” and tap Send."
must_not: A red error for a message that is only slow

steps.action: Tap "Verify with WhatsApp" again within a minute; then many times
user_sees: "You tapped "Verify with WhatsApp" a moment ago. Wait <n> seconds, then try again."
"Too many tries for this number. Wait an hour, then try again."
must_not: Unlimited tries

steps.action: While WhatsApp checking is down
user_sees: "Checking by WhatsApp is not working right now. Please try again later."
must_not: No way to make a gym at all while the check is down, with no word on what to do

start: "Create my gym" form, filled and terms ticked; a check was started

steps.action: Wait until the minutes run out
user_sees: "This code has run out. Tap "Verify with WhatsApp" to get a new one." and the green button
must_not: The old code still accepted after it ran out
A countdown that goes below zero

steps.action: Tap "Verify with WhatsApp" again and send the new message
user_sees: "Number checked"
must_not: The first, old message counted for the new check

steps.action: Tap "Use a different number"
user_sees: The form again, the number box ready to change
must_not: The old number still treated as checked

steps.action: Open the same check in a second tab so the first tab's proof is already taken
user_sees: "This code has run out…" and the button to start again
must_not: The page waiting for ever

steps.action: After "Number checked", wait more than 15 minutes, then tap "Create my gym"
user_sees: "This check has run out. Tap "Verify with WhatsApp" to check your number again."
must_not: A used or old check accepted
A dead end

start: "Create my gym" form, filled and terms ticked

steps.action: Do the check, then look at the page, the address bar and the WhatsApp chat
user_sees: The chat holds only the short message with a code; the page shows the own number only
must_not: The mobile number in the address bar
The number kept by MettleUp for this check after it is used
The check passing for a number the person does not hold
Marketing messages sent to the number after the check
